summary: `library_index.storageUrl` (written via extForContentType) and the real Storage write location (actualStoragePath via firebase-storage.ts:getStoragePath) diverge for text/image uploads. PNG: index says `library/{fileId}.png`, real bytes at `library/{fileId}`. Atomic-guard read-verify uses actualStoragePath (correct), but any reader consuming library_index.storageUrl directly (vs /api/drive/file/{fileId}) gets a 404. Source comment acknowledges the back-compat reason but it's a foot-gun for new readers and a latent fragility for image/text charts.
repro: src/lib/library-upload.ts lines 126-151 (compare extForContentType vs actualStoragePath); also line 435 (storageUrl write) vs line 442 (verifiedSize read).
observed: extForContentType returns '.txt', '.png', '.jpg'; actualStoragePath returns '' for those mimes. Index field and real path mismatch for every text/image upload.
expected: Single source of truth for the storage path; storageUrl field matches actualStoragePath, or storageUrl is derived from fileId+mime at read time.
